races.name: Community Engagement Programme Handicap
races.verdict:
HOPE RISING was again dominant when supplementing her recent Lingfield success at Nottingham 7 days ago and with the drop back in trip holding no fears, a quick-fire hat-trick looks on the cards.

  1. HOPE RISING (IRE)
  2. SNEAKY BLINDER (FR)

races.name: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Clive Cox has his team in good form so SOEUR DE FLASH is given a chance to build on her promising first run at Windsor. Dual runner-up Delightfully Hot looks sure to be on the premises again, while Sioux Moon is open to progress on the back of her debut third.

  1. SOEUR DE FLASH
  2. DELIGHFULLY HOT
  3. SIOUX MOON

races.name: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The form of GROVE STREET's promising debut second at Sandown 3 weeks ago is already working out well and with progress anticipated from starts 1-2, he earns the vote to come out on top. Avionics raced too freely last time and can be afforded another chance, whilst La Bassette rates a likely improver having shown ability in a well-contested maiden on debut. Talamon is an interesting newcomer to note, too.

  1. GROVE STREET
  2. AVIONICS (IRE)
  3. LA BASSETTE (IRE)

races.name: Trade Centre Wales Handicap
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances but RISEN AGAIN hails from a stable going well (4 winners across last 2 meetings here) and signalled he could well be ready to strike when second at Yarmouth 16 days ago. He shades preference over Look Back Smiling who has been shaping up pretty well for his new yard and has the assistance of Tom Marquand today. Rating and class-dropping Law of Design complete the shortlist.

  1. RISEN AGAIN (FR)
  2. LOOK BACK SMILING (IRE)
  3. RATING (IRE)

races.name: Trade Centre UK Handicap
races.verdict:
VON TROTTER relished this extra distance when off the mark in clear-cut fashion at Doncaster and he looks capable of defying a 7 lb rise. Handicap debutant Rogue Exile is a potential improver so rates the main threat ahead of Honky Tonk Girl.

  1. VON TROTTER
  2. ROGUE EXILE (IRE)
  3. HONKY TONK GIRL

races.name: Saxon Automobiles Handicap
races.verdict:
ARNAZ goes unpenalised for last week's emphatic success in a C&D apprentice race and he ought to take some stopping on that evidence reunited with Billy Loughnane. Connie's Rose and recent Leicester scorer Calafrio are others to consider, with last year's winner Vape and Some Nightmare others entering the reckoning.

  1. ARNAZ
  2. CONNIE'S ROSE
  3. CALAFRIO

races.name: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is much easier than the race SAIFO tackled on debut and he's narrowly preferred to Franschhoek, who shaped nicely when third on his debut in the spring.

  1. SAIFO (IRE)
  2. FRANSCHHOEK
  3. WHY NOT ME

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JAVELOT made an encouraging start to his career at Yarmouth and gets the vote ahead of Tom Ward's Southwell fifth Peaberry. The booking of Oisin Murphy for newcomer Maliqui takes the eye and this Sands of Mali gelding would also enter calculations should the betting vibes be strong.

  1. JAVELOT
  2. PEABERRY
  3. MALIQUI (IRE)

races.name: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap
races.verdict:
The strong feeling is that SPACEMAN has a bigger performance in him over 7f and on this just his fifth start, he looks the answer. Recent Kempton scorer Percy's Lad and Haaderr head the opposition.

  1. SPACEMAN (IRE)
  2. PERCY'S LAD
  3. HAADERR

races.name: Surestore Self Storage Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
It might be worth chancing SAILOR'S RETURN, who has been running better than her form figures might indicate on turf since coming to Britain and her best efforts in France were achieved on all-weather. Blue Celestial has been knocking on the door in similar company and is second choice ahead of Gladiadora and the hat-trick seeking Samra Star.

  1. SAILOR'S RETURN
  2. BLUE CELESTIAL
  3. GLADIADORA (IRE)

races.name: Maggies Handicap
races.verdict:
SARGENT DENNIS was a shade disappointing on handicap debut at Doncaster but this mark really should be within range so he's taken to bounce back in style. Acclaimed Freedom may up his game post gelding operation, with Arishka's Dream one of few in this who may get back on track returned to this surface.

  1. SARGENT DENNIS (IRE)
  2. ACCLAIMED FREEDOM
  3. ARISHKA'S DREAM

races.name: Self Storage Association Handicap
races.verdict:
Harry Eustace 3-y-o FLASH KOZO has a progressive profile on all-weather and might be able to cope with a 5 lb rise for Southwell. Dance Time, So Alex and Kakirra head the dangers in a competitive finale.

  1. FLASH KOZO (IRE)
  2. DANCE TIME
  3. SO ALEX (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
CIRCUIT BREAKER's strike rate tempers enthusiasm slightly but this represents a drop in class and with Simon Walker doing the steering, he may well take full advantage. Diamond Bay and the returning Flamingo Rose are potential threats.

  1. CIRCUIT BREAKER
  2. DIAMOND BAY
  3. FLAMINGO ROSE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROMOTOSO produced a promising first effort at Doncaster early this month and can provide her stable with another 2-y-o winner. Past Passion is next best back down in class ahead of the newcomer Enriched.

  1. ROMOTOSO
  2. PAST PASSION
  3. ENRICHED

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
CHARLES MORIN is given another chance in this company in a change of headgear. Foinix and Fighting Poet finished 1-2 in a similar event over C&D last week and they head the dangers.

  1. CHARLES MORIN
  2. FOINIX
  3. FIGHTING POET (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
MY OLD MATE landed the odds with a fair amount up his sleeve at Windsor a week ago and assuming he's as effective on the all-weather, the hat-trick beckons. Perfect Ruler has left a leading stable but joined another very capable one and she may offer most resistance.

  1. MY OLD MATE (IRE)
  2. PERFECT RULER
  3. HENFIELD

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ZALTALLA has made a positive start for this yard and has a good chance on these terms. The drop back in trip looks a good move for Turpin so he's next best ahead of Victory Sound.

  1. ZALTALLA (FR)
  2. TURPIN
  3. VICTORY SOUND (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ROVINIA arrives in fine heart and only narrowly failed to return to winning ways at Brighton last time. She looks the one to beat. Megaphone and Chloe's Courage may provide the chief threat.

  1. ROVINIA
  2. MEGAPHONE
  3. CHLOE'S COURAGE

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
HAPPIER is a mare in form and a penalty for last week's Ffos Las victory may not be enough to prevent her completing the hat-trick here. Due Date and Alashos should also go well.

  1. HAPPIER (IRE)
  2. DUE DATE
  3. ALASHOS (FR)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
VON KROLOCK is having his first start on all-weather since running out a convincing winner at Wolverhampton in the spring so he could be the answer to the finale. Walking On Clouds would be a serious threat if allowed to dictate again, while it will be interesting to see if there is market support for My Mate Kev again.

  1. VON KROLOCK (IRE)
  2. WALKING ON CLOUDS (IRE)
  3. MY MATE KEV

races.name: QuinnBet Apprentice Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
SHE'S IDEAL is thriving at present and having displayed a good attitude to follow up her claiming success for Paul Flynn in a 16-runner handicap at Gowran last week, she's fancied to complete the hat-trick. Forlio can be given another chance dropping in grade on his return to this code, while Darkdeserthighway left the impression she should have won on her most recent outing and also needs considering, for all that she faces a stiffer task on these terms.

  1. SHE'S IDEAL (IRE)
  2. FORLIO
  3. DARKDESERTHIGHWAY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
EIGHTEENTH SMILES didn't get the breaks when third on his nursery debut at Galway last month and remains with potential. He could be the answer here. Luca Brillante and Cashel Queen head the list of dangers.

  1. EIGHTEENTH SMILES (IRE)
  2. LUCA BRILLANTE (IRE)
  3. CASHEL QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Race
races.verdict:
SEVEN NATION ARMY looked potentially useful in making his second nursery start a winning one in impressive fashion at Galway 19 days ago and looks one to keep firmly on side. He's taken to get the better of his stablemate Green Dreamer, who ran out of a ready winner of a 1m Leopardstown maiden recently and can progress further. Noble Agenda's debut form has worked out better than expected and he shouldn't be taken lightly, either.

  1. SEVEN NATION ARMY (GER)
  2. GREEN DREAMER (IRE)
  3. NOBLE AGENDA (IRE)

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
Several of these should be winning races, with ALMEIYDA taken to get off the mark after close calls here and at Galway. Stooked and Flower Forest are a couple of the other likely sorts.

  1. ALMEIYDA (IRE)
  2. STOOKED (IRE)
  3. FLOWER FOREST (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider but 3-y-o CONTRARY TO LAW has the right sort of profile for this so could be the answer with a well-run race sure to be in his favour. Cool Azul and Earls are potential dangers.

  1. CONTRARY TO LAW (IRE)
  2. COOL AZUL (IRE)
  3. EARLS (IRE)

races.name: District Speciality Coffee Maiden
races.verdict:
ALMAZANN shaped with plenty of promise in a pair of maidens that have worked out well during the spring and returning with his yard amongst the winners, Dermot Weld's charge makes plenty of appeal. Magnum Cor shaped with definite promise also when fourth in a Leopardstown maiden 12 days ago and rates a big threat, ahead of Sunny South West.

  1. ALMAZANN (IRE)
  2. MAGNUM COR (IRE)
  3. SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)

races.name: Class Grass Handicap
races.verdict:
COULSTYS WAY was still in contention when unshipping her rider at Galway last month and had posted a good third at Killarney previously. She gets the nod in a open-looking finale. Lady Plimsoll, Lily Parr and Yquem make up the shortlist.

  1. COULSTYS WAY (IRE)
  2. LADY PLIMSOLL (IRE)
  3. LILY PARR
